text:
Alice Nguyen: Hey — scorecard drilldown for quantize-experiment-2026 is showing wrong sample rows, looks like offsets shifted after the runner job
Ben Patel: Ugh, saw this in staging too yesterday :grimacing:
Carla Mendez: Can you paste the run id and a short repro? I'll try locally
Alice Nguyen: run_id=qe-2026-04-12-77a3, failing sample id range shown 120-140 but those rows map to very different prompts in the raw dataset
Alice Nguyen: screenshot: https://s3.redwood.example/err/qe-77a3-drill.png
EvalBot: run qe-2026-04-12-77a3 finished (status: completed, metrics: stable). CI link: https://ci.redwood/queue/77a3
Dmitri Ivanov: My guess: runner's sample shuffling / seed mismatch vs dashboard prefiltering
Maya Kapoor: The frontend drilldown query uses sample_index not global_id — could be a join bug when we switch to paginated exports
Samir Shah: Quick check: telemetry shows scorecard row_count=200 but drilldown returned 180 rows
Ben Patel: I saw a similar issue when we toggled "include_cached_prefix=true" in the eval runner
Carla Mendez: Steps I will try: 1) pull runner outputs for qe-77a3 2) run frontend SQL used by drilldown 3) compare sample_ids
Carla Mendez: SQL snippet I'll run:
```
SELECT global_id, sample_index, prompt FROM eval_outputs WHERE run_id='qe-2026-04-12-77a3' ORDER BY sample_index LIMIT 200;
```
Alice Nguyen: if it is sample_index vs global_id mismatch, that explains the perceived "regression" in quantized model quality
Dmitri Ivanov: Also check CI artifact naming — we had a bug where artifacts uploaded with prefix "eval-" got reindexed
Maya Kapoor: @Carla please paste diffs into the thread
Carla Mendez: Ran it — confirmed: sample_index sequence is contiguous but global_id mapping is shuffled. Attach diff: https://s3.redwood.example/diffs/qe-77a3-map.txt
Samir Shah: OK that means dashboard selection uses global_id but scorecard agg used sample_index. We'll need a small migration or fix in query
Ben Patel: Proposed fix: change drilldown query to join on run_id + sample_index -> global_id mapping table
Alice Nguyen: Can someone pick this up as a quick patch? It's showing up in customer-facing reports
Maya Kapoor: I'll log a ticket and assign to eng-ml oncall
Maya Kapoor: ticket: INF-4389 — title: scorecard drilldown global_id/sample_index mismatch
EvalBot: Ticket INF-4389 created and linked to run qe-2026-04-12-77a3
Carla Mendez: I'll open a PR with the query change and a unit test comparing mappings
Dmitri Ivanov: Also add an integration test in eval-runner CI to assert artifact upload naming doesn't change
Alice Nguyen: thanks team :thumbsup: will follow up in morning, tagging @Ben for rollout coordination
Ben Patel: On it — will coordinate with eng-platform for a quick hotfix rollout to staging :eyes:
